records.source: Persistent, selectable explanations of every element in a pipeline.
records.translation: Viðvarandi, veljanlegar skýringar á hverjum þætti í vinnslurás.

records.context: Show a workflow's dependency stages as module and connection cards.

records.source: Show a pipeline's dependency stages as module and connection cards.
records.translation: Sýna skref í háðaröð vinnslurásar sem spjöld fyrir einingar og tengingar.

records.context: owning dialog. Cards fill its available width, and text wraps when the window width changes. Selecting a graph element only changes its border; it never rebuilds the text or scrolls the panel.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pipeline_details.PipelineDetails#1
records.source: owning dialog. Cards fill its available width, and text wraps when the window width changes. Selecting a graph element only changes its border; it never rebuilds the text or scrolls the panel.
records.translation: Yfirskipaður svargluggi. Spjöld fylla tiltæka breidd hans og texti brotnar í línur þegar breidd gluggans breytist. Val á þætti í grafinu breytir aðeins jaðri hans; það endurgerir aldrei textann né skrunar spjaldinu.

records.source: Create a rounded, translucent pane with a stable scroll position.
records.translation: Búa til ávalt, hálfgegnsætt svæði með stöðugri skrunstöðu.
